candidates.spoken: What If We Swam in Europa's Ocean?
A vast, dark ocean that could host life, reachable only through ice.
Europa hides more water than all Earth's oceans.
Its ocean may be 2 to 3 times Earth's ocean volume.
This leads to a volume of Europa's oceans of 3×1018m3.
Plumes of water may erupt through cracks.
Reaching the water would still mean drilling through ice.
It would not all happen at once.
It's under an icy shell on a moon of Jupiter.
So the best place to look for life may be under ice.
In 2022, Juno flew within 320 kilometres of it.

script.spoken: Europa hides more water than all Earth's oceans. It's under an icy shell on a moon of Jupiter. Its ocean may be 2 to 3 times Earth's ocean volume. The rigid top layer of ice may be as thin as 200 metres. Plumes of water may erupt through cracks. In 2022, Juno flew within 320 kilometres of it. Reaching the water would still mean drilling through ice. So the best place to look for life may be under ice, not on land.
